title: From an answer, the step's layer is an existing control null that already carries layers (Shake Control): that is Set the pivot's, never this lesson's. The mentor says so plainly, names the pivot lesson in words, and doesn't teach a null

steps.text: Move Shake Control to where the hammer hits without the letters jumping.

note: Spec 014 T058 (routing; FR-027: an existing control null's pivot routes to Set the pivot). The real path never gets here on A: go_deeper refuses a null that carries children with ROUTE_TO_PIVOT before it saves a hand-in, and the ask mentor then names Set the pivot instead (ask unit tests cover that). This case is the second guard, the skill's own line, for a hand-in that names the control null among a step's layers or an older session.
